schedule.frame_capture: One in-run natural baseline plus six positive/negative/restore frames
schedule.periodic_capture_policy: No periodic captures; exact Root-rebound PID/slot requests only.
schedule.timeouts: canonical 420 seconds; helper 410 seconds; exact owned marker 20 seconds; held-player window 10 seconds; missing witnesses defer without retry.

forcing_policy.control_writes: Only the two selected menu bools are written, after the natural baseline, for the six enumerated state frames and final restoration.

protocol.setup: Open the console once and exec the private setup script to register exactly the two short constructor-variable aliases and bind F1/F2; require a fresh Enter plus both exact alias-query receipts derived from the same target paths passed to registration, then close the console and capture the natural baseline in this same owned run before any control writes. No component activation command is sent.
protocol.stage: Use the observed 62091 F1 handoff: each stage is queued through F1, exact alias ACK is indexed relative to the pre-F1 cursor before F2, F2 reads both aliases, and the indices are retained inside the SHA256 complete-line window.
protocol.frame: Use the observed exact named frame-request event keyed by owned PID/new slot, check the exact PID/slot/sequence/present/file ACK, and hash the captured BMP/CSV receipt.
protocol.readback: Every initial/state/final F2 raw indexed value line must equal the expected TRUE/FALSE literal. Each bound prefix independently determines its zero-based begin-line index. Capture acceptance rows use one-based line numbers; motion/ACK use zero-based indexes. F1 -> F2 -> fresh engine2 and actual slot0 held brake/handbrake physics -> exact ACK -> present-matched raw CSV/BMP are checked for baseline and all six states.
protocol.final_restore: The last Prop restore state is the successful final cleanup: both original false values, indexed F1/F2, fresh held-player/motion, seventh exact ACK/CSV/BMP. Cleanup adopts that actual captured restore transaction and performs no later successful-path variable writes. If incomplete, retain an explicit fallback paired restore attempt but grant no final-frame credit and fail machine evidence.

geometry_review.required_world: After the run, Root personally identifies the actual current player track unit and visible world geometry in the in-run natural baseline and state frames; absence means defer the world control.
geometry_review.required_prop: After the run, Root personally identifies a visible non-instanced prop inside the original strict <2000 camera range; absence means defer the prop control.
geometry_review.positive_negative_restore: After the run, Root inspects the baseline and all six positive/negative/restore frames, compares each positive image with that control's paired negative and restore images, and defers no-effect, unobserved, ambiguous, or occluded geometry.
geometry_review.disposition: No prior HUD slot-4/f0b8 image or pixel approval is required. Machine evidence stays pending Root's post-run visual review; no inventory completion is written before that review.
